injuries.name: Jonathan Isaac
injuries.detail: Isaac (knee) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Celtics.

injuries.name: Noah Penda
injuries.detail: Penda (hamstring) is making progress but remains without a timetable to return to game action, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

injuries.name: Paolo Banchero
injuries.detail: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Izaiyah Nelson
injuries.detail: Team president Jeff Weltman said Monday that Nelson (ankle) remains about a month away from returning to the court after offseason surgery, per Philip Rossman-Reich of OrlandoMagicDaily.com.

missing_list.name: LeBron James

reasoning: On the season so far the 76ers are the stronger team; with home court the Magic start about 0 points better, in a game of about 223 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 2 points towards the Magic.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Magic win 57 times in 100, by about 2; most games like this end between 197 and 246 total points.
